data.name: Liberty Star Sunset Sail
data.headline: 2 Hour Boston Harbor Sunset Sail
data.description:
#Enjoy a Boston Sunset Sail aboard a classic schooner.

If Boston is best seen from the water, then by far the best time to see it is during a sunset cruise on a classic Boston tall ship! We depart Fan Pier Marina and raise the sails, then it’s time to just chill out and relax.

The Star can accommodate up to 39 passengers in addition to a crew of 3. Get away from the hustle and bustle of the city streets and enjoy some quality time out on the water with unbeatable views of the skyline sparkling in the twilight.
data.what_is_included: Drinks are available onboard for purchase via cash, credit, or Apple Pay - our menu includes several beers brewed right here in South Boston! We also have red and white wine, vodka- and rum-based cocktails, soda, juice, and water available in addition to several snack options.
data.what_to_bring: You are welcome to bring your own snacks, but please no coolers or outside beverages.
data.cancellation_notes: The Liberty Fleet reserves the right to cancel any sail for inclement weather, a private charter event, or other unforeseen circumstances. If the Company cancels your cruise you may reschedule to another comparable sail, or if unable to reschedule you will receive a full refund for the ticket price. We know plans change – if you need to cancel your sail please let us know more than 48 hours in advance and we will refund the full ticket price. We do not offer refunds for cancellations less than 48 hours before your scheduled sail.
data.booking_notes:
#Thank you for booking with Liberty Fleet!

---

Please arrive 15-30 minutes prior to the sail so you don't miss the boat! If you don't see the boat at the dock they are still out with the previous sail. 

We embark and disembark passengers at **Fan Pier Marina**; please see [this link](https://libertyfleet.com/location/) for a map and additional details. 

As it can be cooler on the water you may want to bring a light jacket or sweater. We also recommend closed-toes shoes.

Please refer to our [FAQ section](https://libertyfleet.com/faq/) or call the office with any questions - (617) 742-0333. 

Minimum drinking age is 21 years.  Onboard we accept Apple Pay, credit cards, or cash.

---

See you soon!
data.disclaimers: There is no formal narration during our public sails, but feel free to ask the captain and crew and they’ll happily share their knowledge of local landmarks and history.
